remarks: Fabulous opportunity to live in one of Stamford's most sought-after luxury buildings. One Strawberry Hill has a 24-hour doorman to greet you and your guests and hold your packages, a beautifully furnished lobby, library, two exercise rooms and a fabulous, heated pool. This apartment has two good sized bedrooms, two full marble baths, dining area off the kitchen and a large living room with sliders to your own western facing balcony. You'll see amazing sunsets. A full-size washer and dryer are in the unit. One garage parking space comes with the apartment and a 2nd space can be rented. There is also ample parking for your guests. The building is located just steps from the heart of downtown Stamford, offering great restaurants, shopping, library, movie theatres, a seasonal farmers market and a short walk to the train. A short drive will take you to the Merrit Parkway, I95 and Stamford beaches. The building's recent updates include a new roof, newer paint and carpet on the hallways of all floors, new windows and sliders and new decking around the pool. Good credit a must. Photos are from previous tenant.
